frame.name: Terminal menu / search, new session, settings

text.name: 720px terminal width. No smaller text. Wrap prompts and options; keep the source gutter. Transcript scrolls; current input stays reachable.
Input belongs to the foreground owner. A custom shell prompt means shell; alo ❯ means an alo session. Prompt text alone is not authentication.

Choose [1/2/3] reads keyboard input in alo. Enter cancels where stated. Ctrl+C cancels that pending choice; it does not stop an unrelated background server. Normal child-process interruption follows foreground process ownership.

Source gutter: terminal-owned, outside clipped program content. PROGRAM includes parsed rich results. SYSTEM means an attributed observation, with scope and time. ALO is interpretation. YOU is input. Colour is supplementary.
Permissions status opens the effective grant. Changing autonomy is explicit and revocable. Stopping or revoking does not undo completed side effects. No silent permission expansion.
Screen reader: announce source once per region. BLOCKED announces the refused action and that permissions did not change, without moving focus. Never announce each streaming token.

History has retention and privacy controls. Show unavailable observations or checkpoints honestly. Secrets are not deliberately copied into receipts. Restore scope excludes remote effects and process state.
Source marks are protected in the live terminal, not authenticated in an arbitrary screenshot. All shown measurements are illustrative design content.
